task.title: Remove a tree from the list
task.shortdesc: Take a tree off the Workspaces page without deleting its file.

step.cmd: On , find the card of the tree.

stepresult.p: A box named asks you to check. It says Remove 'Brontë family of Haworth' from your workspaces? This does not delete the family tree file on disk. The name in the question is the name of your tree.

step.cmd: Choose in the box, or to stop.

result.p: The card is gone. The file is still in its folder. Open it again with at any time.
If that was your only tree, the top of the window says No workspace open. The page says No workspaces found. Open a family tree file to get started. The buttons and are still there.
result.note: Do not make a new tree with the name of a tree you removed in the same session. The new tree mixes up its data with the old one until you close and open it again.
result.p: To start clean with that name, do these things in this order:

ol.li: Remove the old tree, as above.
Create the new tree. says how.

result.p: If you open with no tree, it may make an empty tree called default. It holds nobody. You can remove it in the same way.
